Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding academic credit for prior learning.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to academic credit for prior learning; and addinga new section to chapter 28B.50 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28B.50 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The college board, the higher education coordinating board, thecouncil of presidents, the fouryear institutions of higher education,the private independent higher education institutions, and the privatecareer schools shall collaborate to carry out the following goals: (a) Increase the number of students who receive academic credit forprior learning and the number of students who receive credit for priorlearning that counts towards their major or towards earning theirdegree, certificate, or credential; (b) Increase the number and type of academic credits accepted forprior learning in institutions of higher education; (c) Develop transparent policies and practices in awarding academiccredit for prior learning; (d) Improve consistency in prior learning assessment practicesacross the institutions of higher education; p. 1 HB 1522 (e) Create tools to develop faculty and staff knowledge andexpertise in awarding credit for prior learning and to share exemplarypolicies and practices among institutions of higher education; (f) Develop articulation agreements when patterns of credit forprior learning are identified for particular programs and pathways; and (g) Develop outcome measures to track progress on the goalsoutlined in this section. (2) The college board shall convene the academic credit for priorlearning work group. (a) The work group must include the following members in additionto representation from the college board: (i) The higher education coordinating board; (ii) The workforce training and education coordinating board; (iii) The council of presidents; (iv) Representatives from Washington institutions of highereducation; (v) Representatives from faculty of two and four-year institutionsof higher education; (vi) Representatives from private career schools; and (vii) Representatives from business and labor. (b) The purpose of the work group is to coordinate and implementthe goals in subsection (1) of this section. (3) The college board shall report progress on the goals andoutcome measures annually by December 31st. All entities listed insubsection (2)(a) of this section shall collaborate with the collegeboard to provide information for tracking purposes. (4) The office of financial management shall work with the collegeboard, the higher education coordinating board, and the fouryearinstitutions of higher education to track the number of studentsreceiving academic credit for prior learning and the type of creditawarded at institutions of higher education. This information shall beincluded among the outcomes tracked in RCW 43.41.400(2)(f) beginning in2013. (5) For the purposes of this section, "prior learning" means theknowledge and skills gained through work and life experience; throughmilitary training and experience; and through formal and informal HB 1522 p. 2 education and training from in-state and out-ofstate institutionsincluding foreign institutions.
